name: Chocolate Mousse
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Melt chocolate, add powdered sugar, and gradually one cup cream.
Stir over fire until boiling-point is reached, then add gelatine dissolved in boiling water, sugar, and vanilla.
Strain mixture into a bowl, set in a pan of ice-water, stir constantly until mixture thickens, then fold in the whip from remaining cream.
Mould, pack in salt and ice, and let stand four hours.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
